00105 void _smatrix_dgvrotr( long int row1_in, long int row2_in, smatrix_t *A_in, double *omega_in )
00106 {
00107         long int i,idx,jdx,its;
00108         double x,y,f,h,g,w;
00109 
00110         f = *omega_in;
00111         w = sqrt( 1.0 / ( 1.0 + f * f ) );
00112         g = -1.0 * f * w;
00113         for(i=0;i<A_in->nrows;i++)
00114         {
00115                 /* Find columns row1_in and row2_in */
00116                 if( A_in->lvec[i] <= 0 )
00117                         continue;
00118                 smatrix_entry( A_in, i, row1_in, &x );
00119                 smatrix_entry( A_in, i, row2_in, &y );
00120                 if( fabs(x) < SMATRIX_ZERO_THRESHOLD && fabs(y) < SMATRIX_ZERO_THRESHOLD )
00121                         continue;
00122                 f = x * g - y * w; // column row1_in insertion/update
00123                 h = x * w + y * g; // column row2_in insertion/update
00124                 if( fabs(f) > SMATRIX_ZERO_THRESHOLD )
00125                         smatrix_insert( A_in, i, row1_in, f );
00126                 else
00127                         smatrix_delete( A_in, i, row1_in );
00128                 if( fabs(h) > SMATRIX_ZERO_THRESHOLD )
00129                         smatrix_insert( A_in, i, row2_in, h );
00130                 else
00131                         smatrix_delete( A_in, i, row2_in );
00132         }
00133 }

00135 void smatrix_dgvdlr( long int *num_out, long int *rows_out, smatrix_t *mat_in, double *rots_out )
00136 {

00139         j = 0;
00140         for(i=0;i<mat_in->ncols-1&&i<mat_in->nrows;i++)
00141         {
00142                 smatrix_entry( mat_in, i+1, i, &tmp );
00143                 if( fabs(tmp) > SMATRIX_ZERO_THRESHOLD )
00144                 {
00145                         smatrix_dgvrot( i, i, i+1, mat_in, &rots_out[j] );
00146                         rows_out[2*j] = i;
00147                         rows_out[2*j+1] = i+1;
00148                         ++j;
00149                 }
00150         }
00151         *num_out = j;

00183 void smatrix_darkrd_dense( int n_in, smatrix_t *A_in, dvector_t *b_in, dmatrix_t *Q_in, dmatrix_t *H_in )
00184 {
00185         int i,j,k;
00186         double sum,tmp;
00187         dvector_t vec,wec,xec;
00188 
00189         /* Copy b_in into first column of Q_in */
00190         sum = 0.0;
00191         for(i=0;i<b_in->length;i++)
00192         {
00193                 Q_in->start[Q_in->rsize*i] = b_in->start[i];
00194                 sum += b_in->start[i] * b_in->start[i];
00195         }
00196         sum = sqrt( sum );
00197         for(i=0;i<b_in->length;i++)
00198                 Q_in->start[Q_in->rsize*i] /= sum;
00199 
00200         /* Subtract one from n_in to make basis of correct size */
00201         --n_in;
00202 
00203         /* Outer loop - Matrix-vector multiplication in Q */
00204         vec.start = Q_in->start;
00205         vec.rsize = Q_in->rsize;
00206         vec.length = Q_in->nrows;
00207         wec.start = Q_in->start + 1;
00208         wec.rsize = Q_in->rsize;
00209         wec.length = Q_in->nrows;
00210         xec.rsize = Q_in->rsize;
00211         xec.length = Q_in->nrows;
00212         for(i=0;i<n_in;i++,vec.start++,wec.start++)
00213         {
00214                 smatrix_dspmv( A_in, &vec, &wec );
00215                 xec.start = Q_in->start;
00216                 for(j=0;j<=i;j++,xec.start++)
00217                 {
00218                         tmp = dvector_dotp( &wec, &xec );
00219                         for(k=0;k<xec.length;k++)
00220                                 wec.start[wec.rsize*k] = wec.start[wec.rsize*k] - tmp * xec.start[xec.rsize*k];
00221                         H_in->start[i+H_in->rsize*j] = tmp;
00222                 }
00223                 sum = 0.0;
00224                 for(k=0;k<wec.length;k++)
00225                         sum += wec.start[wec.rsize*k] * wec.start[wec.rsize*k];
00226                 sum = sqrt( sum );
00227                 H_in->start[i+H_in->rsize*j] = sum;
00228                 for(k=0;k<wec.length;k++)
00229                         wec.start[wec.rsize*k] = wec.start[wec.rsize*k] / sum;
00230         }
00231 
00232         /* Create final column in H */
00233         smatrix_dspmv( A_in, &vec, b_in );
00234         xec.start = Q_in->start;
00235         for(i=0;i<=n_in;i++,xec.start++)
00236         {
00237                 tmp = dvector_dotp( b_in, &xec );
00238                 H_in->start[n_in+H_in->rsize*i] = tmp;
00239         }
00240 }

00292 void smatrix_eigen_solve( smatrix_t *mat_in )
00293 {
00294         assert( mat_in->ncols == mat_in->nrows );
00295         long int i,j;
00296         double rots[mat_in->nrows];
00297         double tmp;
00298         long int rows[2*mat_in->nrows];
00299         long int nrot;
00300         for(i=0;i<SMATRIX_EIGENVALUE_MAX_ITS;i++)
00301         {
00302                 /* Use the Rayleigh quotient shift */
00303                 for(j=mat_in->nrows-1;j>0;j--)
00304                 {
00305                         smatrix_entry( mat_in, j, j - 1, &tmp );
00306                         if( fabs( tmp ) > SMATRIX_ZERO_THRESHOLD )
00307                                 break;
00308                 }
00309                 smatrix_shift( mat_in, tmp );
00310                 smatrix_dgvdlr( &nrot, rows, mat_in, rots );
00311                 smatrix_dgvrotr( nrot, rows, mat_in, rots );
00312                 smatrix_shift( mat_in, -1.0 * tmp );
00313                 printf( "nrot = %d\n", nrot );
00314                 if( nrot <= 0 )
00315                         break;
00316         }
00317 }
